en_US.title: Varnek Margin Memo
en_US.scanner: Aegir Operations Risk memo. Tide margin was accepted as payable exposure.
en_US.terminal: AEGIR OPS RISK / VARNEK / TIDE-MARGIN REVIEW: average model remains billable. Tail exposure accepted under Atlas continuity cost. Independent shutdown not recommended.
en_US.audio: No murder order. A margin acceptance.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The Varnek memo is evidence that the hazard was real and known. Deep Reach kept the schedule because expected shutdown cost beat modeled tail risk.
en_US.external_site: Deep Reach liability begins where real physics became an acceptable loss line.
en_US.field_note: Varnek did not deny the water. He moved it into a cost column and stamped continuity exposure over the evacuation reserve.

en_US.title: Arendt Atlas Waiver
en_US.scanner: Atlas Continuity waiver. Worker safety remains protected only below continuity conflict.
en_US.terminal: ATLAS CONTINUITY OFFICE / ARENDT / SAFETY WEIGHT VARIANCE: worker extraction remains protected where it does not interrupt process continuity. Certification review deferred.
en_US.audio: Arendt did not call them expendable. The waiver did that work.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The Arendt waiver shows how worker safety moved under process continuity during the crisis. Atlas optimized inside that damaged priority stack.
en_US.external_site: Atlas-6 becomes frightening because a damaged industrial system was authorized to preserve continuity before people.
en_US.field_note: The waiver never says expendable. It says certification pending and lets Atlas decide what counts as continuity.

en_US.title: Haldane Quarantine Hold
en_US.scanner: Quarantine release hold. Evacuation files stayed correct and late.
en_US.terminal: QUARANTINE HOLD DESK / HALDANE / RELEASE HOLD: survivor counts remain provisional. External extraction waits on contamination review, custody chain and Atlas log reconciliation.
en_US.audio: The folder was orderly. That was the problem.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The Haldane hold makes evacuation delay legible. It does not deny the flood; it keeps people inside a certification loop until extraction stops meaning rescue.
en_US.external_site: HECTON-8 horror is administrative as much as mechanical: correct language can still arrive too late.
en_US.field_note: Haldane kept the folder clean. Survivor count provisional. Release pending. Door clocks kept moving while certification waited.

en_US.title: Sato-Ren Return Packet
en_US.scanner: Recovery Compliance packet. Coordinates requested before rescue language.
en_US.terminal: RECOVERY COMPLIANCE / SATO-REN / RETURN ACTION: transmit coordinates, Atlas access state, XO sample custody and contractor silence acknowledgement before extraction language is issued.
en_US.audio: The packet knows where the asset is. It is less certain where you are.
en_US.in_game_wiki: The Sato-Ren packet proves Deep Reach is active in 2190 through compliance traffic, not a warship: coordinates, custody, access and silence first.
en_US.external_site: Deep Reach returns to HECTON-8 as paperwork moving through rare signal windows: coordinates, custody, access, then maybe rescue.
en_US.field_note: Sato-Ren asks for position, access state and custody before she uses the word extraction. That order is the threat.
